Today in 1994, Street Fighter's Akuma made his Debut

By the release of Super Street Fighter 2 Turbo in 1994, Capcom had already re-released Street Fighter 2 three times. But like its predecessors, this iteration brought its own new mechanics. The most obvious change at a glance though is the original secet character in the series.

If you could beat the game's first ten rounds without using more than one credit and under a certain time restriction, you would get your boss fight with M Bison interrupted as Akuma came out of nowhere and knocked the dictator flat. Here comes a new challenger! And he will kick your ass using a similar style as Ryu and Ken.

Akuma has gone on to be one of the faces of Street Fighter, along with Ryu and Chun Li.He kept on showing up in Street Fighter games up until SFV. This included games that often left behind much of the SF2 cast, like Street Fighter III Street Fighter EX. He even got into Street Fighter: The Movie - The Game as a basic starting character, despite not being in that movie.

Akuma has also been in many of Capcom's other fighters, including their crossovers. This included SNK vs Capcom, Marvel vs Capcom. He also has found his way into seemingly random stuff like Asura's Wrath, Tekken 7, and some mech game called Cyberbots.
